# Inter

Inter Variable is bundled locally for PKMS V1.5's reference-aligned interface typography.

- Upstream: https://github.com/rsms/inter
- Font: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsms/inter/master/docs/font-files/InterVariable.woff2
- Italic: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsms/inter/master/docs/font-files/InterVariable-Italic.woff2
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included in `LICENSE.txt`.
- Retrieved: 2026-10-08.
- Runtime assets: `apps/desktop/src/assets/InterVariable.woff2` and `InterVariable-Italic.woff2`.

The font is served from the application bundle; interface rendering does not request a remote font service. Heptabase's private text, account information and bundled assets are not included.
